newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia official sees 49 pct Svyazinvest sale in 97.
newsitem.headline: Russia official sees 49 pct Svyazinvest sale in 97.

text.p: Russia's new reformist government plans to sell 49 percent of telecoms holding company Svyazinvest but will not now relinquish a controlling stake in the firm, deputy prime minister Vladimir Bulgak said on Monday.

"We have an insistent wish, as do buyers, to sell 49 percent of Svyazinvest this year, partly to domestic financial structures, partly to foreign ones," said Bulgak, who was Communications Minister until he received his new post earlier this month.
"Sale of the controlling stake (owned by the state) in Svyazinvest is not being considered in the near future," he said.
Bulgak said the government was ready to order the Svyazinvest sale and to transfer a controlling stake in Rostelekom long distance company to Svyazinvest.
"Regarding Rostelekom and Svyazinvest, presidential decrees and government orders are ready...The issue of a merger with Svyazinvest (by Rostelekom) is being considered by lawyers," he said.
